 UEFA Champions League Match Schedule for October 21, 2026
 Marina Magomedova 21/10/2026 08:09 On Wednesday, October 21, the third round of the group stage of the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 season will take place. 
 Here’s the schedule for the matchday:
 UEFA Champions League Group Stage, October 21 (GMT+3):
 Como vs Manchester United (19:45); 
 Lille vs Galatasaray (19:45); 
 Real Betis vs Feyenoord (22:00); 
 Sporting vs LASK (22:00); 
 Club Brugge vs Lens (22:00); 
 Aston Villa vs Viking (22:00); 
 Bayern Munich vs Arsenal (22:00); 
 Inter vs Shakhtar Donetsk (22:00); 
 Real Madrid vs RB Leipzig (22:00). 
 The current tournament champion is Paris Saint-Germain. In the final of the previous edition, the Parisians defeated Arsenal 1-1 (4-3 on penalties).
